inducement--noun.def: Something offered to persuade a person to act.
inducement--noun.ex: Free travel was the main inducement.

indulgently--adv.def: In a way that allows someone more freedom than is wise.
indulgently--adv.ex: He smiled indulgently at the child.

inexorability--noun.def: The quality of being impossible to stop.
inexorability--noun.ex: The inexorability of ageing troubles him.

infallibility--noun.def: The state of never being wrong.

infallibly--adv.def: Without ever failing or being wrong.
infallibly--adv.ex: The dog infallibly finds the scent.

infernally--adv.def: Extremely and annoyingly, in informal use.

ingenuous--adj.def: Honest and trusting in a way that seems inexperienced.

ingenuously--adv.def: In an innocent and openly trusting way.

ingratiate--verb.def: To act so that someone will like and favour you.
ingratiate--verb.ex: He tried to ingratiate himself with the boss.

ingratiating--adj.def: Trying too obviously to win someone's approval.

ingratiatingly--adv.def: In a way that openly seeks another's approval.

insular--adj.def: Interested only in your own group and closed to outsiders.

interrogative--adj.def: Having the form of a question, in grammar.

intersperse--verb.def: To place things at intervals among others.

interweave--verb.def: To weave or combine things closely together.
interweave--verb.exTr: Roman üç hikâyeyi iç içe geçiriyor.

intrinsically--adv.def: By its own nature rather than by circumstance.

irrelevancy--noun.def: Something that has no bearing on the matter.
irrelevancy--noun.ex: His age is an irrelevancy here.

kinetically--adv.def: In terms of movement or its energy.

lamentation--noun.def: Loud expression of grief or regret.

lassitude--noun.def: A feeling of tiredness and lack of energy.

laud--verb.def: To praise someone publicly and warmly.

leaven--verb.def: To make dough rise, or to lighten something serious.

leavening--noun.def: A substance that makes dough rise.
leavening--noun.ex: Add the leavening at the end.

locomotion--noun.def: The ability to move from one place to another.

luridly--adv.def: In a shockingly detailed or unpleasantly bright way.
luridly--adv.exTr: Hikâye çarpıcı ve çiğ biçimde anlatıldı.

lyrically--adv.def: In a way that expresses feeling beautifully.
lyrically--adv.ex: He writes lyrically about the sea.

lyricist--noun.def: A person who writes the words of songs.

magnanimity--noun.def: Generosity towards someone weaker or defeated.
magnanimity--noun.ex: He showed magnanimity to his rival.

magnanimously--adv.def: In a generous and forgiving way.

malleability--noun.def: The ease with which something can be shaped or influenced.
malleability--noun.ex: Gold is valued for its malleability.

marketability--noun.def: How easily something can be sold.

materialization--noun.def: The becoming real of something expected.
materialization--noun.ex: We await the materialization of the funds.

melodiously--adv.exTr: Çanlar kulağa hoş gelecek biçimde çaldı.

menacingly--adv.def: In a way that suggests harm is coming.

mesmeric--adj.def: Holding attention completely, as if by a spell.
mesmeric--adj.ex: The dancer has a mesmeric presence.

metalled--adj.def: Surfaced with broken stone, said of a road.
metalled--adj.ex: A metalled road reaches the farm.
metalled--adj.exTr: Çiftliğe mıcırla kaplı bir yol gidiyor.

methodological--adj.def: Relating to the methods used in research.

methodologically--adv.def: In terms of the methods used.

midwifery--noun.def: The profession of helping women give birth.

mien--noun.ex: He has the mien of a soldier.

modernism--noun.def: An artistic movement that broke with traditional forms.

moribund--adj.def: Close to ending or failing completely.

mottled--adj.def: Marked with patches of different colours.
mottled--adj.ex: The leaf is mottled with brown.

mull-over--verb.def: To think about something slowly and carefully.
mull-over--verb.ex: She mulled over the offer all weekend.
mull-over--verb.exTr: Teklifi bütün hafta sonu enine boyuna düşündü.

mundanity--noun.def: The quality of being ordinary and dull.
mundanity--noun.ex: He escaped the mundanity of the office.

munificence--noun.ex: The wing exists thanks to her munificence.

muscle-bound--adj.def: So muscular that movement becomes stiff.

mutinous--adj.def: Refusing to obey those in charge.

mutinously--adv.def: In a way that refuses to obey authority.

nascent--adj.exTr: Yeni doğan bir sektör desteğe muhtaç.

neophyte--noun.def: A person new to a subject or activity.

nonchalantly--adv.def: In a calm way that suggests you do not care.

nostalgically--adv.def: With a fond longing for the past.

octogenarian--noun.def: A person between eighty and ninety years old.

opacity--noun.def: The quality of not letting light through, or of being unclear.
opacity--noun.ex: The opacity of the rules frustrates staff.

opulence--noun.def: Great wealth shown in a luxurious way.

opulently--adv.def: In a rich and luxurious manner.

ordain--verb.def: To appoint someone as a priest, or to order officially.

ostensible--adj.def: Stated as the reason though probably not the real one.

paradoxically--adv.def: In a way that seems to contradict itself yet is true.
paradoxically--adv.exTr: Paradoksal biçimde, daha az çalışmak işe yaradı.

paralyzingly--adv.def: So strongly that it stops you from acting.

patchily--adv.def: Well in some parts and badly in others.

patronizingly--adv.def: In a way that treats others as less capable.

pervasiveness--noun.def: The quality of being present everywhere.
pervasiveness--noun.ex: The pervasiveness of screens worries parents.

perversity--noun.def: A habit of acting against reason or expectation.
perversity--noun.ex: Out of sheer perversity he refused.

philanthropically--adv.def: In a way that gives generously to help others.

physiologically--adv.def: In terms of how the body functions.

plutocrat--noun.def: A person whose wealth gives them political power.
plutocrat--noun.exTr: Her iki gazete de bir zenginin elinde.

ponderous--adj.def: Slow and heavy, or dull and overly serious.
ponderous--adj.ex: The report is long and ponderous.

posit--verb.def: To put forward an idea as a basis for argument.
posit--verb.ex: The theory posits an unseen force.
posit--verb.exTr: Kuram görünmez bir güç ileri sürüyor.

postural--adj.def: Relating to the way the body is held.
postural--adj.exTr: Duruş sorunları sırt ağrısına yol açar.

precociously--adv.def: With ability that arrives unusually early.
precociously--adv.exTr: Yaşından beklenmeyecek kadar erken okumaya başladı.

preconception--noun.def: An opinion formed before knowing the facts.
preconception--noun.ex: Leave your preconceptions at the door.

predilection--noun.def: A strong liking for one kind of thing.
predilection--noun.ex: He has a predilection for old maps.
